import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] combs = new long[62][62];
    static long[][] A = new long[32][32];
    static long[][] B = new long[32][32];
    static long totalComb;
    static int R, C, n;
    static char[] pattern = new char[110];
    static long[][] CC = new long[32][32];
    static long minDiff;
    static List<Pair<Long, Long>>[][] P = new ArrayList[32][2];
    static List<Pair<Long, Long>>[][] Q = new ArrayList[32][2];
    static long totalRes = 0;

    static class Pair<L, R> implements Comparable<Pair<L, R>> {
        public L first;
        public R second;

        public Pair(L first, R second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }

        @Override
        public int compareTo(Pair<L, R> o) {
            if (first instanceof Long && o.first instanceof Long) {
                return Long.compare((Long) first, (Long) o.first);
            }
            return 0;
        }
    }

    static void addPath(int x, int y, long g, long c1, long c2, int ck, List<Pair<Long, Long>>[][] P, List<Pair<Long, Long>>[][] Q) {
        if (x + y == R + n) {
            P[x][ck].add(new Pair<>(g, c1));
            if (c2 != 0) Q[x][ck].add(new Pair<>(g, c2));
            return;
        }
        addPath(x + 1, y, g + (! (ck != 0) ? A[x + 1][y] : 0), c1, (pattern[x + y] != 'B' ? c2 : 0), ck, P, Q);
        addPath(x, y + 1, g + (ck != 0 ? B[x][y + 1] : 0), c1, (pattern[x + y] != 'A' ? c2 : 0), ck, P, Q);
    }

    static void calcMin(int x, int y, long g, int ck, List<Pair<Long, Long>>[] P_list) {
        if (x + y == R + n) {
            List<Pair<Long, Long>> list = P_list[x][ck];
            if (list.isEmpty()) return;
            int t = lowerBound(list, new Pair<>((totalComb + 1) / 2 - g, 0));
            if (t != list.size() && list.get(t).second > 0) {
                long tp = (list.get(t).first + g) * 2 - totalComb;
                if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
                if (minDiff > tp) minDiff = tp;
            }
            if (t > 0 && list.get(t - 1).second > 0) {
                long tp = (list.get(t - 1).first + g) * 2 - totalComb;
                if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
                if (minDiff > tp) minDiff = tp;
            }
            return;
        }
        if (x > 0) calcMin(x - 1, y, g + (! (ck != 0) ? A[x][y] : 0), ck, P_list);
        if (y > 0) calcMin(x, y - 1, g + (ck != 0 ? B[x][y] : 0), ck, P_list);
    }

    static void calcMax(int x, int y, long g, int ck, List<Pair<Long, Long>>[][] Q_list) {
        if (x + y == R + n) {
            List<Pair<Long, Long>> list = Q_list[x][ck];
            int t = lowerBound(list, new Pair<>((totalComb + 1) / 2 - g, 0));
            if (t != list.size() && list.get(t).second > 0) {
                long tp = (list.get(t).first + g) * 2 - totalComb;
                if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
                if (minDiff == tp) {
                    totalRes += list.get(t).second;
                }
            }
            if (t > 0 && list.get(t - 1).second > 0) {
                long tp = (list.get(t - 1).first + g) * 2 - totalComb;
                if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
                if (minDiff == tp) {
                    totalRes += list.get(t - 1).second;
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        if (pattern[x + y - 1] != 'B') calcMax(x - 1, y, g + (! (ck != 0) ? A[x][y] : 0), ck, Q_list);
        if (pattern[x + y - 1] != 'A') calcMax(x, y - 1, g + (ck != 0 ? B[x][y] : 0), ck, Q_list);
    }

    static void compress(List<Pair<Long, Long>> P) {
        if (P.isEmpty()) return;
        Collections.sort(P);
        int cnt = 0;
        long sum = 0;
        List<Pair<Long, Long>> newP = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < P.size(); i++) {
            sum += P.get(i).first;
            if (i == P.size() - 1 || !P.get(i).equals(P.get(i + 1))) {
                newP.add(P.get(i));
                sum = 0;
            }
        }
        P.clear();
        P.addAll(newP);
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Pair<Long, Long>> list, Pair<Long, Long> key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid).compareTo(key) < 0) low = mid + 1;
            else high = mid;
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        R = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        C = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        String line = br.readLine();
        pattern = line.toCharArray();

        for (int i = 0; i <= 60; i++) {
            combs[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                combs[i][j] = combs[i - 1][j - 1] + combs[i - 1][j];
            }
        }

        n = R + C;
        totalComb = combs[n * 2][R * 2];

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                if (i > 0) A[i][j] = combs[i - 1][R - 1] * (combs[n * 2 - i][R] - combs[j][R]);
                if (j > 0) B[i][j] = combs[j - 1][R - 1] * (combs[n * 2 - j][R] - combs[i][R]);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
                P[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
                Q[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                CC[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        CC[0][0] = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                if (i != n && pattern[i + j] != 'B') CC[i + 1][j] += CC[i][j];
                if (j != n && pattern[i + j] != 'A') CC[i][j + 1] += CC[i][j];
            }
        }

        for (int i = R; i <= n; i++) {
            if (pattern[i + R - 1] != 'B') addPath(R, i, A[R][i], combs[i + R - 1][R - 1], CC[R - 1][i], 0, P, Q);
            if (pattern[i + R - 1] != 'A') addPath(i, R, B[i][R], combs[i + R - 1][R - 1], CC[i][R - 1], 1, P, Q);
        }

        for (int i = R; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
                compress(P[i][j]);
                compress(Q[i][j]);
            }
        }

        minDiff = totalComb + 1;
        calcMin(n, n, 0, 0, P);
        calcMin(n, n, 0, 1, P);
        calcMax(n, n, 0, 0, Q);
        calcMax(n, n, 0, 1, Q);

        System.out.println(totalRes);
    }
}
